summary: MapleStory entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: MapleStory
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Nexon Windows live-service client

emulation.notes: Use official live service; private-server preservation is outside this official route.

primary.why: MapleStory is an ongoing side-scrolling MMORPG, with current access through both the Nexon Launcher and Steam. Archive fidelity is therefore about recording the current client, world, account, class, and event state rather than finding a static definitive version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Windows client through Nexon Launcher or Steam. Record region, world, character/class, level, client version/date, event state, account/linking state, and whether Reboot/Heroic or regular server rules apply.

all_releases.fidelity: Current official Nexon client and server state.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official main route for current play.

all_releases.fidelity: Alternate official launcher route for the same service.
all_releases.reason: primary: valid official access path, with account-linking caveats.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service version, event, server, and account state define what can be archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document date, server/world, class, account, and current event systems because the game changes over time.
